reviews.text: Andrea and Fabiana, what can I say? Two wonderful people, professional, clean, and friendly. It's hard to find all these qualities these days. I recommend them wholeheartedly 💪 …
Andrea and Fabiana are super professional, kind, and extremely knowledgeable. I highly recommend everyone to try their skills firsthand!

A decidedly negative experience. After arriving late for an appointment and missing two, I was informed that they would no longer be taking my dog. I understand that appointments must be kept and that absences can cause inconvenience, but I find it disproportionate to completely terminate the relationship with a client without even trying to understand the situation.

I would have expected greater professionalism, availability, and above all, a modicum of understanding. Instead, I was met with a very rigid attitude, which I personally didn't appreciate.

A client can make mistakes and admit their mistakes, but I believe the way a business handles such a situation also makes a difference. As for me, after this experience, I won't be returning, and I don't feel comfortable recommending this grooming salon.
